title: Embossing Looks Cheap
text: Embossing Looks Cheap. The color and shape of this vase are beautiful and I love it but the embossing on it is actually pitiful and looks like it was rushed and no time was taken to do it. Honestly, the embossing makes it look cheap because it just isn't done very well. However, with that, the color and shape really make up for it and as long as you don't get up close to it lol it looks really beautiful.

product_metadata.title: Creative Co-Op Embossed Glass, Green Iridescent Finish Vase
features: This embossed glass vase stands out effortlessly with its green iridescent finish, and is perfect for accenting nightstands, dressers, and coffee tables
